question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is three-fifth of the perimeter of a square of diagonal 16sqrt{2} cm. Find the ratio between the area of the triangle and the area of the square.

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

Side of equilateral triangle = Perimeter ÷ 3
